name: Dome of the Rock
text: The Dome of the Rock (Arabic: قبة الصخرة, romanized: Qubbat aṣ-Ṣaḫra) is an octagonal Islamic shrine at the center of the Al-Aqsa mosque compound on the Temple Mount in the Old City of Jerusalem. It is the world's oldest surviving work of Islamic architecture, the earliest archaeologically-attested religious structure to be built by a Muslim ruler and contains the earliest inscriptions proclaiming Islam and the prophet Muhammad. Its initial construction was undertaken by the Umayyad Caliphate on the orders of Abd al-Malik during the Second Fitna in 691–692 CE, and it has been built on top of the Foundation Stone (or Noble Rock).

depictions.name: Dome of the Rock
depictions.text: The Dome of the Rock is an Islamic shrine located in the city of Jerusalem. It was built between 689 and 691 CE atop the Temple Mount, allegedly on the spot of the farthest mosque visited by Muhammad during his Night Journey. As one of the most famous and important shrines in the world, the site of the Temple Mount is considered sacrosanct by the three religions of Islam, Judaism, and Christianity.
